name: algenta_query_sql_report
description: Use the companion algenta_get_contract tool first to inspect the live machine-readable contract, then discover one authorized dataset with lexical search, fetch its low-token summary, and run a constrained read-only SQL report through /v1/query/sql-report. Use this tool only for wide rowset reports that do not fit one governed exact query or governed exact-query batch.

dataset_search.description: Lexical search hint for dataset discovery. Example: orders, revenue, support.

dataset_id.description: Optional explicit dataset_id. If present, skip lexical search and use this dataset directly.

sql.description: Read-only SQL statement over the authorized dataset alias. Example: select order_month, gross_revenue from orders order by order_month desc limit 12

alias.description: Optional SQL alias for the authorized dataset source.

max_rows.description: Maximum number of rows to return from the SQL report.
